# STAC67H3: Regression Analysis
### Department of Computer and Mathematical Sciences — UTSC
Comprehensive study hub for linear models, generalized least squares, model validation, and computational statistics in R and Python.

::: {.card-grid}
::: {.course-card}
### 📊 [Lecture Notes](notes/index.qmd)
Matrix derivations of OLS estimators $\hat{\boldsymbol{\beta}} = (\mathbf{X}^T\mathbf{X})^{-1}\mathbf{X}^T\mathbf{y}$, Gauss-Markov theorem, hat matrix $\mathbf{H}$, and ANOVA decompositions.
:::

::: {.course-card}
### 📝 [Assignments](assignments/index.qmd)
Worked solutions to theoretical homework problems, mathematical proofs, and data analysis case studies.
:::

Diagnostic plotting scripts, multicollinearity VIF calculations, Cook's distance analysis, and LASSO/Ridge regularization.
